set.body:
Outcome
Make dense data views usable through selection, editing, overflow and focus transitions.

Owned scope
meridian-theme table/tree/list/tab/scrollbar recipes; virtualized fixtures

Prerequisites
B3

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Cover TableView, TreeTableView, TreeView, ListView, TabPane, headers, sorting and scrollbars with realistic cells, icons, numeric alignment and empty/loading/error content.
- [ ] Verify active/inactive selection, selection+focus, disabled+selected, editing+invalid, cell commit/cancel, long labels and horizontal/vertical overflow.
- [ ] Virtualized cell reuse clears stale style/state/validation from previous rows; editable contents and font enlargement can exceed default row minima.
- [ ] Columns preserve stable numeric alignment with the chosen font strategy; scientific values and formatting semantics are unchanged by theme/density.
- [ ] Sampler has deterministic 0/1/many/100000 row cases; no per-cell shadows, idle animations or theme-triggered scientific work.

Required evidence
Selection/edit/reuse regression probes, geometry captures, virtualized-node counts and deterministic data assertions.

Completion rule
Record exact candidate/revisions, commands and exit status, retained evidence paths, and applicable limitations. No unrun checks or browser-only captures establish native correctness. Keep provider/app ownership in its own tracker. Implementers reserve exact paths before editing; shared source files have one writer. Use review until the stated reviewer/gate accepts.

Plan
PLAN.md — acceptance backlog code C2. Mote is authoritative for status and dependencies.
set.title: [C2] Complete virtualized data and selection controls
